Superior to a thousand droṇapuṣpa flowers is the flower of the khadira;

superior to a thousand śamī flowers is the bilva flower;
superior to a thousand bilva flowers is the baka flower;
superior to a thousand baka flowers is the nandyāvarta;
superior indeed to a thousand nandyāvartas is the karavīra.
The white flower is best among a thousand karavīras;
better than the white karavīra flower is the pālāśa flower.
Superior to a thousand pālāśa flowers is the kuśa blossom;
superior indeed to a thousand kuśa blossoms is the wild garland.
Superior indeed to a thousand wild garlands is the campaka;
superior to a hundred campaka flowers is the aśoka flower.
Superior to a thousand aśoka flowers is the śevantī flower;
superior to a thousand śevantī flowers is the kujaka flower.
Superior indeed to a thousand kujaka flowers is the mālatī flower;
superior to a thousand mālatī flowers is the sandhyā flower.
Superior indeed to a thousand sandhyā flowers is the trisandhyā flower;
superior to a thousand red trisandhyās is the white trisandhyā;
superior to a thousand white trisandhyās is the kunda flower.
Superior indeed to a thousand kunda flowers is the jātī flower;
among all classes of flowers, the jātī flower is best here.

2.5.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां द्वितीये वैष्णवखण्डे ब्रह्मविष्णुसंवादे मार्गशीर्षमासमाहात्म्ये मथुरामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तदशोऽध्यायः .. 17 ..
2.5.m: Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Mathurā', in the Māhātmya of the Month of Mārgaśīrṣa, in the dialogue between Brahmā and Viṣṇu, in the second [section], the Vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

2.5.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe dvitīye vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍe paṃcamaṃ śrīmārgaśīrṣamāsamāhātmyaṃ saṃpūrṇam .. ( 2-5) ..
2.5.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराणे द्वितीये वैष्णवखण्डे पंचमं श्रीमार्गशीर्षमासमाहात्म्यं संपूर्णम् .. ( 2-5) ..
2.5.m: Thus ends the fifth [sub-section], the glorious Māhātmya of the Month of Mārgaśīrṣa, in the second [section], the Vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. (2.5)
May this be offered to glorious Kṛṣṇa.
Now begins the fifth [sub-section], the Māhātmya of Mārgaśīrṣa, in the Vaiṣṇavakhaṇḍa. (2.5)

2.5.m: 4. Description of the fruit of bearing the heated cakra mark and wearing a rosary of lotus seeds and tulasī; the māhātmya of wearing a garland of myrobalan fruits; the māhātmya of wearing tulasī wood; description of the manner of installing, meditating upon, and worshipping the image of the Lord; description of the sequence with mantras for worshipping the conch and so forth. 195.2
5. The māhātmya of the fruit of the bath with the five nectars; the māhātmya of the bath with water from a conch; narration of the fruit of worshipping the conch. 196.2
6. Description of the māhātmya of the sound of the bell; the fruit of worshipping the image of the Lord; narration of the fruit of offering tulasī-wood sandalwood paste. 197.1

2.5.d: 7 भगवदर्पितजातिपुष्पफलमाहात्म्यवर्णनम, भगवत्प्रियपुष्पाणां वर्णनम्, सर्वपुष्पाणां मध्ये जातिपुष्पश्रैष्ठ्यमाहात्म्यम, विष्णुकंठे जातिसहस्रपुष्पांकितमालास्थापनफल- माहात्म्यवर्णनम. ... ... .. 198 1

Description of the māhātmya of the fruit of jātī flowers offered to the Lord; description of flowers dear to the Lord; the māhātmya of the superiority of the jātī flower among all flowers; description of the māhātmya of the fruit of placing a garland adorned with a thousand jātī flowers on the neck of Viṣṇu. 198.1

2.5.m: 8. Description of the māhātmya of tulasī; obtaining the fruit of giving all objects through the gift of a tulasī leaf; description of the fruit of worshipping the Lord with tulasī; the māhātmya of the fruit of offering incense and lamps; the māhātmya of a lamp endowed with a thousand wicks. 198.2
9. Narration of the injunctions according to the treatises for cooked food, side dishes, and the like in the vessel of food offering. 199.2

2.5.m: 10. Narration of the māhātmya of the rite of worshipping the Lord after the food offering; narration of the fruit of circumambulation and so forth; the fruit of reciting the thousand names of Viṣṇu; narration of the cause of the Lord obtaining the name Dāmodara; the māhātmya of partaking of the tīrtha and food offering; conclusion of the worship ritual, its concluding ceremony, and narration of its fruit. 200.2

2.5.s: 11 vīrabāhurājakathāsaṃdarśanapūrvakamekādaśīmāhātmyam, bharadvājena vīrabāhunṛpasyātithyakaraṇam, bharadvājena vīrabāhoḥ prāgjanmavṛttāntakathane prāgjanmani śūdreṇa brāhmaṇasatkārajanyātpuṇyādiha janmani rājyaprāptivṛttāntavarṇanama...... 201 1

2.5.m: 11. The māhātmya of the Ekādaśī preceded by illustrating the story of King Vīrabāhu; Bharadvāja offering hospitality to King Vīrabāhu; in Bharadvāja's narration of the account of Vīrabāhu's previous birth, the description of the account of obtaining kingship in this birth from the religious merit born of a Śūdra's hospitality to a brahmin in a previous birth. 201.1

2.5.s: 12 vīrabāhunā prāgjanmanyātmanaḥ śūdratvaprāptikāraṇaṃ pṛṣṭena devaśarmaṇā dvijena prāgbrāhmaṇatvaṃ gatenāpi daśamīyutadvādaśīsvīkaraṇadoṣeṇa tasya śūdratvaprāptivṛttāntakathanapūrvakaṃ daśamīyutadvādaśīniṣedhakathanaga, prāgjanmani viprātithyādisukarmaṇā śūdratve'pi tasya sanmatirjātā'to'vaśyamevātithisatkāraḥ kārya ityādivarṇanaṃ ca, rājñe bharadvājenaikādaśīvratodyāpanavidhikramavarṇanama, akhaṇḍaikādaśīvratakathanama.. 203 1
2.5.d: 12 वीरबाहुना प्राग्जन्मन्यात्मनः शूद्रत्वप्राप्तिकारणं पृष्टेन देवशर्मणा द्विजेन प्राग्ब्राह्मणत्वं गतेनापि दशमीयुतद्वादशीस्वीकरणदोषेण तस्य शूद्रत्वप्राप्तिवृत्तान्तकथनपूर्वकं दशमीयुतद्वादशीनिषेधकथनग, प्राग्जन्मनि विप्रातिथ्यादिसुकर्मणा शूद्रत्वेऽपि तस्य सन्मतिर्जाताऽतोऽवश्यमेवातिथिसत्कारः कार्य इत्यादिवर्णनं च, राज्ञे भरद्वाजेनैकादशीव्रतोद्यापनविधिक्रमवर्णनम, अखण्डैकादशीव्रतकथनम.. 203 1
2.5.m: 12. King Vīrabāhu having asked about the cause of his attaining the state of a Śūdra in a previous birth, the narration by the twice-born Devaśarman of the account of his attaining the state of a Śūdra due to the flaw of observing Dvādaśī combined with Daśamī, despite having previously been a brahmin, followed by the prohibition of Dvādaśī combined with Daśamī; the description that even though he became a Śūdra, righteous discernment arose in him on account of the good deed of hospitality to a brahmin in a previous birth, and therefore hospitality to guests must certainly be performed; the description by Bharadvāja to the king of the sequence of the rite for the concluding ceremony of the Ekādaśī observance; narration of the unbroken Ekādaśī observance. 203.1
13. The māhātmya of the night-vigil on Dvādaśī; the sequence of rites of gifts and so forth during the vigil; description of the eligibility of a son born of Dvādaśī. 204.4

2.5.s: 14 dvādaśyāṃ matsyotsavamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvakasnānadānapūjādividhividhānakathanam, matsyotsave mantrajapavidhānam, snānasamaye nadīprārthanāmantrakathanam, bhagavate phalapuṣpādyarpaṇaphalakathanam, matsyarūpasvarṇamūrtidānamāhātmyavarṇanam. ... 205 2

2.5.m: 14. Narration of the rules and injunctions for ablution, gift, worship, and so forth preceded by a description of the māhātmya of the Matsya festival on Dvādaśī; the rule for muttering mantras during the Matsya festival; narration of the prayer mantra to the river at the time of the bath; narration of the fruit of offering fruits, flowers, and the like to the Lord; description of the māhātmya of donating a golden image in the form of a fish. 205.2

2.5.s: 15 mārgaśīrṣe dampatipūjanaprakārakathanam, gobhūmisvarṇavastraśayyālaṃkārasadmadānamāhātmyam ,bhagavatpūjāsamaye phalapuṣpadānamāhātmyam, mārgaśīrṣaṃ dānādibhirbrāhmaṇasaṃtopakaraṇamāhātmyam, mārgaśīrṣe bhagavannāmasmaraṇamāhātmyam

2.5.m: 15. Narration of the manner of worshipping a married couple in Mārgaśīrṣa; the māhātmya of the gift of cows, land, gold, garments, beds, ornaments, and dwellings; the māhātmya of offering fruits and flowers at the time of worshipping the Lord; the māhātmya of satisfying brahmins with gifts and so forth in Mārgaśīrṣa; the māhātmya of remembering the names of the Lord in Mārgaśīrṣa.

2.5.s: 16 bhagavaddhyānaṃ tanmāhātmyaṃ ca, bhagavatstotropadeśādhikāravarṇanam, guruśiṣyalakṣaṇam, bhāgavatamāhātmyavarṇanam, bhāgavataphalaśrutiḥ, bhāgavatagranthārcanapūrvakapaṭhanaphalavarṇanam 207
2.5.d: 16 भगवद्ध्यानं तन्माहात्म्यं च, भगवत्स्तोत्रोपदेशाधिकारवर्णनम्, गुरुशिष्यलक्षणम्, भागवतमाहात्म्यवर्णनम्, भागवतफलश्रुतिः, भागवतग्रन्थार्चनपूर्वकपठनफलवर्णनम् 207

Meditation on the Lord and its māhātmya; description of the eligibility to impart the hymn of praise to the Lord; the characteristics of guru and disciple; description of the māhātmya of the Bhāgavata; the statement of fruits of the Bhāgavata; description of the fruit of reciting the Bhāgavata scripture after worshipping it. 207
